projects.title: Personal Developer Portfolio
projects.bodyText:
- Responsive and modern personal developer portfolio built with **React** and **Vite**.
- Features dark/light mode toggle, dynamic JSON-driven content sections, and smooth animations.
- Configured for fast deployment on **Vercel**.

projects.title: Full Stack Web Application
projects.bodyText:
- End-to-end full stack web application developed during internship/coursework.
- Responsive client interface built with **React.js** and backed by **MongoDB / SQL**.
- Implements CRUD operations, secure user data handling, and RESTful API endpoints.

projects.title: Database Management & Utility System
projects.bodyText:
- Core software solution demonstrating algorithmic problem solving and database design.
- Built with **Python / C++** and relational **SQL** database queries for optimized data retrieval.
- Clean modular structure adhering to best coding standards.
